text:
Ava: Quick sync — running a 30m lightning lab next Thurs 11am PT to demo the OSS starter kit + a tiny performance snapshot. Format: 5m scaffold, 6m wiring model, 6m perf before/after, 13m live Q&A. Need copy, gating, and lead routing.
Jon: Sounds good. Audience = community devs + engineers exploring infra. Keep CTA developer-friendly: repo link + one-line script.
Priya: For signup, propose a single dropdown: Company size (indie, startup, growth, enterprise). Map to CRM lists & add utm tags. Who drafts the field labels?
Marco: Perf angle: show baseline vs "Fast Path" (batching + kv cache + quant). Report p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens, and throughput. Small chart and a 3-bullet narrative.
Ava: Action items: Jon -> social + email; Marco -> run micro-bench and share CSV; Priya -> create HubSpot form + automations; Liam -> hero image + thumbnail for recording. I'll do slides + demo script.
Jon: Copy idea: "30m hands-on lab: wire an OSS starter kit and drop inference costs. Live examples + metrics. Thu 11am PT. Register: https://tiny.red/mini-lab". Email subject candidates: "Hands-on: Build & Optimize in 30m" / "Cut inference cost — live lab"
Priya: Hidden fields: lead_source=lightning-lab-2026, utm_campaign=lightning-lab. HubSpot listId=46200, lifecycleStage=lead, ownerRotation=sd-community. Tag: lightning_lab_2026.
Marco: Benchmark commands (will include exact numbers in deck):
```bash
# run baseline
python demo.py --model small --batch 1 --quant none --runs 200
# fast-path
python demo.py --model small --batch 8 --quant int8 --kv_cache yes --runs 200
```
I'll compute p95 and $/1k tokens from the logs and export CSV.
Ava: Include a 2-line code CTA in the email linking to the repo, e.g.:
```python
from redwood import Client
print(Client().generate("short summary: '...'"))
```
Keeps it actionable.
Jon: I'll prepare three social variants: short tweet, 2-post X thread, full LinkedIn post. Scheduling: community channels 24h and 1h warnings.
Priya: Routing rules: if user chooses "enterprise" -> tag AE-inbound + add to SDR queue; otherwise MQL drip (3 emails over 7 days). Add automation: if attendee downloads benchmark CSV -> tag as engaged.
Liam: I'll make a compact hero (800x400) and a 5s animated thumbnail for the recorded highlight. Posting schedule for assets?
Ava: We should record and clip a 4-5m highlight for on-demand distribution. Also publish the benchmark CSV and a short explainer blog post.
Marco: Recording plan noted. I'll attach the CSV and the mini-chart after the runs.
Jon: Draft copy done, will drop in calendar for approval. Need the canonical registration URL from Priya before finalizing.
Priya: Creating the HubSpot form now, will paste final URL + field mapping here shortly. Hidden field values set.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Lightning Lab: OSS starter kit" Thu 11:00 PT — reminders: 24h, 1h, 10m.
Ava: Final checklist: slides (Ava), benchmark CSV + chart (Marco), copy + schedule (Jon), form + automations (Priya), hero/thumb (Liam). Ping this thread when each is done. :rocket:
